title: Policy 463.10 monthly audits — first portal production after the policy took effect
summary:
Re-requested the monthly audit memoranda § 463.10 describes, this time through the portal after Policy 463.10 took effect on 2025-12-22.

Produced four memos (Dec 2025, Jan 2026, Feb 2026, Mar 2026) addressed to the Chief, each dated within 1–14 days of the audited month.

policy_promises.quote: the memorandum shall include any data errors found so any such errors can be corrected
policy_promises.tests: What error-finding does each memo describe?

policy_promises.quote: the memorandum and any associated documentation shall be filed and retained
policy_promises.tests: What 'associated documentation' (review notes, intermediate query results) is retained alongside the memos?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012129 produced three monthly memos via email. This portal request was filed after Policy 463.10 formally took effect to record the four memos under the new policy.

filed_because: Policy 463.10 was added to Policy 463 on 2025-12-22. The request asks for the audit memoranda produced under the new policy.
notes:
The produced memos describe audits of 'internal and external ALPR usage.' Their substantive content reviews SMPD's sharing configuration.

§ 463.10 separately describes a quarterly audit covering external CA public agency users' search activity. Follow-ups W012665-050426 (April/May continuation) and W012666-050426 (SOP 205.5.1 records) cover those scope items.
